title: TDA known-answer suite on simple spaces (LeanFlow TEST_USE_CASES section 2) -- expectations written BEFORE any homology was computed
rules: LeanFlow CLAUDE.md sections 2, 4, 5, 6 apply. Expected topology is tier L (literature). Every observed number will be tier X (numerics). Nothing here is 'proved'.

disclosure_pre_expectation_probes.statement: Before this file was written, three timing-only probes were run in the scratchpad (not committed) to decide which complexes are feasible. disclosure_pre_expectation_probes.consequence: Alpha is used in R3 (pipeline function) and in R4 (pipeline for Z/2, direct gudhi for Z/3). Alpha is not used in R5/R6. Rips thresholds are kept below the Vietoris-Rips circle threshold sqrt(3)*radius (L = 1.2 for references, 1.6 for T3) because L = 2.0 exceeds it on every circle factor.

code_under_test.cosmic_web_tda_scaled: audit/reverse_zero/E5-cosmic-web-tda-scaled/cosmic_web_tda_scaled.py: alpha_persistence, betti_curve, euler_curve, top_bars, build_circle_cloud, build_planted_void_cloud
code_under_test.cmb_tda: audit/reverse_zero/E5-cmb-tda/cmb_tda.py: build_topology, betti_curves_from_topology, coarse_stats (N_BINS=8, NU grid [-4,4] 41 points)
code_under_test.import_method: importlib.util.spec_from_file_location under a module name != '__main__'; both files guard main() with if __name__ == '__main__'
code_under_test.reference_paths: gudhi.RipsComplex (+ SimplexTree.collapse_edges, expansion), gudhi.AlphaComplex directly, gudhi.CubicalComplex, gudhi.PeriodicCubicalComplex
limitations_known_from_source_before_run: alpha_persistence hard-codes homology_coeff_field=2: the Z/3 halves of P5 and P6 cannot go through it and use gudhi.AlphaComplex directly on the same points (same complex: simplex counts compared).
alpha_persistence keeps only dims 0,1,2 (by_dim = {0:[],1:[],2:[]}); betti_curve/euler_curve use dims 0-2 only. beta_3 (P7) is invisible to the pipeline; P7 uses Rips directly.

betti_curves_from_topology returns Betti CURVES (b0, b1, chi=b0-b1) on a caller grid, not bars; it standardises the field by its std. 'chi' there is b0-b1, not the Euler characteristic of the complex (b2 ignored).

build_topology links 8-neighbour HEALPix pixels and fills every 3-clique; 4 mutually adjacent pixels around a pixel corner then give 4 triangles with no tetrahedron (a hollow 2-sphere). Expectation for the full-sky complex, if it were a triangulated S2: (b0,b1,b2) = (1,0,1). Prediction written in advance: b2 > 1 is likely (extra hollow tetrahedra); b0 and b1 are unaffected.

definitions.bars: Alpha: radius units (sqrt of gudhi alpha^2, as alpha_persistence does). Rips: edge length. Infinite deaths are replaced by a cap: the truncation radius if the complex is truncated (r_trunc, or L for Rips); otherwise the largest finite death over all dimensions of that diagram.
definitions.persistence_order: p_1 >= p_2 >= ... per dimension; p_j = 0 if fewer than j bars.
definitions.dominant_rule: For an expected beta_k = b >= 1: PASS_k iff p_b >= 5 * p_{b+1}.
definitions.zero_rule: For an expected beta_k = 0 (k >= 1): PASS_k iff p_1 < 0.2 * P_all (P_all as in observed_beta), i.e. observed beta_k = 0. If the case expects no bar in any dim >= 1 (P9, N1), the no-dominant-bar rule p_1 < 5 p_2 applies instead.
definitions.observed_beta: observed beta_k = number of bars in dim k with persistence >= 0.2 * P_all, P_all = max persistence over all bars of the diagram in dims >= 1 (capped infinite bars included) -- for H0 the cap-based infinite bar counts. A case PASSES iff, for every checked dimension, observed beta_k == expected beta_k AND the dominant/zero rule holds.
definitions.checked_dimensions: 0..(manifold dimension) for manifolds; dims above that are reported but not gated unless stated.
definitions.null_pvalue: p = (1 + #{null seeds with max persistence in dim k >= observed p_b in dim k}) / (1 + 50), comparing the b-th (weakest expected) bar of the signal to the MAX bar of each null seed (conservative). Minimum attainable p = 1/51 = 0.0196.

cases.pass: dominant_rule for H0 (b=1) and H1 (b=1); zero_rule for H2 (reported, gated); observed_beta == (1,1,0)

cases.source: H_*(RP2; Z) = (Z, Z/2, 0); universal coefficients. Hatcher 2002 Ch. 2 (cellular homology of RP^n) and Sec. 3.A

cases.space: flat 3-torus T3 = (cos a, sin a, cos b, sin b, cos c, sin c) in R6
cases.construction: N in {250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000}, angles uniform (seed 7 for every N; independent draws per N), no noise
cases.method: gudhi.RipsComplex(max_edge_length=1.6) -> 1-skeleton -> collapse_edges to fixpoint -> expansion(4) -> persistence Z/2 (dims 0-3). The pipeline alpha_persistence cannot report H3 (see limitations). L=1.6 lies below the circle threshold sqrt(3)=1.732 (Adamaszek & Adams, Pacific J. Math. 290 (2017) 1-40) so infinite/capped bars are expected; the design band is 2 x covering radius < L < sqrt(3).
cases.pass: dominant_rule with b = 1, 3, 3, 1 in H0..H3 and observed_beta == (1,3,3,1), bars capped at L. Reported: the smallest N in the list that passes, or 'not recovered within budget' (a run exceeding 590 s or 6 GiB is recorded as over budget and larger N are not attempted).

cases.space: 256x256 grid, f = -sum_{i=1..7} exp(-|x - c_i|^2 / (2 * 10^2)), equal depths
cases.expected: 7 local minima -> exactly 7 sublevel H0 bars
cases.tier_expected: L (Morse theory: sublevel H0 births = local minima; Edelsbrunner & Harer, Computational Topology, AMS 2010)
cases.construction: 7 centres drawn (seed 21) uniformly in [30, 226]^2 with minimum pairwise distance >= 50 px (5 sigma), so every saddle value (about -0.09) lies above every minimum (about -1): max_nu b0(nu) = 7

cases.method_pipeline: cmb_tda.betti_curves_from_topology on a Freudenthal triangulation of the grid (4-neighbour edges + one diagonal, 2 triangles per square), unmasked = all vertices, sublevel=True, nu_grid = 4001 points spanning the standardised [min, max]; statistic = max_nu b0(nu)
cases.cross_check: direct count of strict 8-neighbour local minima of f
cases.pass: CubicalComplex count == 7 AND pipeline max_nu b0 == 7 AND direct count == 7; additionally the pipeline b0 at nu = max is 1 and b1 at nu = max is 0 (a disk)

cases.space: HEALPix nside 64, full sky, Gaussian isotropic field
cases.expected: p-values of an independent realisation against a same-C_ell ensemble are uniform on [0,1]
cases.construction: C_ell = exp(-l(l+1) sigma_b^2) / (l(l+1)) for 2 <= l <= 191, C_0 = C_1 = 0, Gaussian beam FWHM 3 deg (sigma_b = FWHM/sqrt(8 ln 2) in radians); 200 realisations hp.synfast(cl, 64, new=True) with np.random.seed(30000 + i), i = 0..199; i < 100 = ensemble, i >= 100 = 100 independent test maps
cases.method: pipeline build_topology(mask = ones, nside = 64), betti_curves_from_topology(sublevel=True, nu_grid = cmb_tda NU grid [-4,4], 41 points), pipeline coarse_stats(sim_curves = ensemble, data_curve = test map) for b0, b1 and chi: Hartlap chi2 survival p-value and empirical rank p-value
cases.pass: for each of b0, b1, chi and the Hartlap p-value: KS test against U(0,1) with p_KS >= 0.01, and #{p < 0.05} <= 9 of 100 (the 97% binomial quantile for rate 0.05). The literal TEST_USE_CASES TDA-7 rule (#{p < 0.05} <= 5 of 100) is also reported; note that a perfectly calibrated test exceeds 5 of 100 with probability about 0.38. Empirical rank p-values: reported (discrete, KS reported, not gated).
cases.topology_diagnostic: gudhi persistence of the full-sky build_topology complex with a constant filtration: expected for S2 (1,0,1); b2 is predicted to exceed 1 (hollow tetrahedra), reported as a pipeline finding, b0 = 1 and b1 = 0 gated
